lines.text: My bike collection is impressive, isn’t it?\c\nI won’t let you ride or buy one, but feel free\nto have a look.
It’s a shiny bike.\nIt looks expensive!
Are you curious about that bike?
I like simple bikes, too.\nIt was a limited edition and popular a while ago.
The refreshing color of the frame\nperfectly matches nature!
It costs ₽1,000,000! Bike enthusiasts\nare tormented by its super rarity!
Although its performance is average,\nit’s super easy to ride.
It’s even easy for beginners to ride!
OK...
It’s a shiny bike.\nIt looks very fast!
Are you curious about those Mach Bikes?
As its name suggests, a Mach Bike is super fast.
The frame in pursuit of lightness!\nUltimate reduced air resistance!
If you put weight on the carbon handlebars,\nit accelerates to top speed in a second!
With the momentum, you can climb any hills\nwith ease!
It’s a bit difficult to control, but even that\nis a lovable feature of the bike.
It’s a shiny bike.\nIt looks tough!
Are you curious about those Acro Bikes?
It’s by far the wildest bike and very different\nfrom other bikes.\r\nThat is the Acro Bike!
It allows you to perform actions such as\nwheelies and bunny hops.
You can even ride it on raised walkways or\ntrackless paths!
You can do acrobatic stuff, so it’s called an\nAcro Bike. That is my own theory, though.
If you value techniques more than anything else,\nthat is the bike for you!
You’re the first person who listened to all of my\nnerdy talk.
You must be a nerd, too!\nAs a token of our new friendship, please\r\ntake this!
My bike collection...\n...Oh, it’s you!\c\nYou can look at my bikes as long as you want!
